svg.aria-label: yolow64: One multishift, eight sextets; Whitespace in two instructions; Where a branch becomes a coin flip; Validate with one and-not; One sign bit catches every bad byte; Stream when 7N/3 outgrows the LLC; Proving a shortcut cannot exist; Speedups as intervals, not anecdotes
svg.title: yolow64 — BIT ALGEBRA × SIMD
svg.desc: One multishift, eight sextets. RFC 4648 Base64 · AVX-512 VBMI. sextet_j = (g ≫ s_j) & 63, s = 42, 36, …, 0. Six bytes per qword are gathered in reverse, and a 192 B block is read as three 64 B loads bridged by vpermi2b — zero read overhang. Whitespace in two instructions. simdjson (VLDB 2019) · Polychroniou et al. (2015). ws(b) ⇔ LUT[b & 0xF] = b. Comparing the table to the byte itself replaces a 7-instruction classifier; AVX-512 compacts with register vpcompressb and full 64 B stores. Where a branch becomes a coin flip. maximum-entropy branch point. (1 − p)^64 = ½ ⇒ p = 1 − 2^−1/64 ≈ 1.08%. Real text sits near the coin flip, so the filter is branch-free: throughput stays flat across densities (Zen 5, 4 KiB). Validate with one and-not. De Morgan · nibble validation (moego). bad = ¬V ∧ H, sextet = min(c + roll, 63). 5 → 4 vpshufb per 32 B block, 12 uops, 4.0 cycles; errors accumulate with saturating vpaddusb on ports 0/1 instead of vpor. One sign bit catches every bad byte. exhaustive over all 256 byte values. v = T[c & 0x7F]; err |= c ∨ v; bad ⇔ MSB(err). A 128-entry table plus one OR covers the whole byte domain, so validation never needs a second pass over the data. Stream when 7N/3 outgrows the LLC. working-set model · research/encode-counters. N + 4N/3 = 7N/3 > C ⇒ stream at N ≥ 3C/7. Not a tuned constant — it follows from the 4/3 output expansion. Measured 1.77× at 16 MiB, beyond the 1.571× traffic ratio. Proving a shortcut cannot exist. exhaustive DFS + z3 · research/decode.md. ¬∃ T_1, T_2 : 5 offsets ✓ ∧ 192 invalid ✗. Self-validating two-table decode looked tempting; the solver showed it is impossible, so the validation step stays explicit. Speedups as intervals, not anecdotes. paired bootstrap · 10,000 resamples. Δ = median(new − old), 95% CI from 10^4 resamples. Paired, interleaved rounds — 3 processes × 7 rotated rounds, median of medians — so a result is a measured interval, not one lucky run.
